methodology: Host CPU is from operating system tick deltas approximately every 30 seconds. Interval values are weighted by overlap with the acquisition window.

The acquisition window starts at creation of the first raw WPT shard log and ends at the last available host interval (interim), or the final raw receipt write (final). Only complete verified receipts written within coveredEnd count.

CI activity and other local compiler lanes are nearest process snapshots within 20 s of interval midpoint. Short tasks can fall between samples. A CI worker process can be present with little CPU work.

Census concurrency changes affect only admissions at shard boundaries. Each shard retains the fixed four-job WPT profile. The controller reserves headroom for feature implementation and independent QA.
No workflow changes were made to the external Actions runner. This file describes machine load, not browser conformance.
